title: Social Program
summary: Planned social and networking events for IEEE SSCI 2027.

sections.heading: Welcome Reception
paragraphs: A sunset welcome reception is planned for the first evening at a scenic outdoor terrace adjacent to the Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre. Delegates will be able to network in a relaxed setting with local cuisine and drinks.

sections.heading: Conference Banquet
paragraphs: The conference banquet is planned for The Star Gold Coast, minutes from the conference venue. The evening is expected to include a three-course menu highlighting Australian cuisine, live local entertainment such as a didgeridoo performance or Indigenous dance, an awards ceremony, and networking zones.

sections.heading: Targeted Networking Events
bullets: Women in Computational Intelligence lunch panel
Industry and academia roundtables during lunch breaks or coffee sessions

sections.heading: Social Events & Networking
paragraphs: The social and networking program is designed to foster collaboration, mentorship, and community-building across career stages, disciplines, and cultures. The Gold Coast's coastal setting provides a memorable environment beyond the academic sessions.
